measurement: TextFormatter.Create().FormatLine(...); per-character advance from TextLine.GetTextBounds; the ACTUAL font and glyph used from the public TextLine.GetIndexedGlyphRuns()

apiNotes.howTheActualFontIsObserved: TextLine.GetIndexedGlyphRuns() (PUBLIC) yields IndexedGlyphRun { TextSourceCharacterIndex, TextSourceLength, GlyphRun }; GlyphRun exposes GlyphTypeface (-> FontUri, FamilyNames), GlyphIndices, AdvanceWidths, BidiLevel and FontRenderingEmSize. No reflection was needed for any value in this oracle.
apiNotes.glyphTypefaceAdvanceWidths: GlyphTypeface.AdvanceWidths maps glyph index -> advance as a FRACTION OF EM; multiplying by emSize gives DIP. Glyph index 0 is .notdef.
apiNotes.glyphRunAdvanceWidths: GlyphRun.AdvanceWidths is reported as WPF returns it, next to the measured DIP advance, so its unit can be read off the data instead of assumed.
